implementation_results.note: Classic-script space-client/1 uses actual demo/1 binding and BoundBridge. It waits for active state, validates snapshots and ACKs, limits size/rate, allows one write, freezes uncertain writes, and supports explicit reconnect. Four client tests include actual bridge, grants, timeout, closure and same-revision replacement.

parse5/TS/PostCSS validate body fragment/classic script and locate bounded diagnostics. Fixed SDK plus author source is deterministic and remains separate from editable source; hashes bind author, SDK, validator, builder, effective source, artifact and report. Original model-v1 is rejected. Four validator tests passed.

Core stage/seal/read under separate author/effective stores, CAS head token, immutable operations, restore, stale receipts, bounded JSON CLI with fixed production root. Concurrency, corruption and real launcher paths passed.

Repair packet contains selected current author source and bounded diagnostics; stale or mismatched application is rejected. BATCH-012 model-v1 was read only, diagnosed, manually statically revised and built as a model_candidate descendant. No model code ran or loaded.

Trusted repository fixture traversed create/edit/check/build/core seal/actual MountCoordinator/BoundBridge/ACK save/switch/undo in jsdom. Fault injection covered stale check/build, failed head publication, SDK identity invalidation and corrupt receipt. Model lineage was denied before frame creation.
Manifest, historical hashes, scope checker and taskctl results are recorded at batch close. Independent review remains pending.
